combined_sha256_algorithm: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(registered_inputs, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'))
registration_precedence: The fixture and plan are byte-identical copies of the sealed materials-only files. Their awaiting-parent status and fixture.protocol.code_freeze_expected=null are historical preparation statements, not an absent current freeze. This separate final registration records the approved frozen code, controls and bounds; do not rewrite the sealed preparation.
task_integrity: Both original natural questions, original v1 PDF bytes and six-dimension 0-4 rubric are unchanged. Materials were selected before V11 production freeze and without inspecting V11 model answers or probing routes/retrieval. Their titles and questions were disclosed only after the parent declared the production fingerprint frozen.
interpretation_limits: Two new-to-repository task pairs only; public/sealed materials are not a model-training holdout, expert certification, statistical superiority result or general product acceptance. Review is developer/AI and must disclose visibility of arm labels.

approved_dispatch.soft_stop_semantics: Observe supplier-reported prompt plus completion tokens after each request; stop before the next request at the limit or when usage is unavailable. This is not a hard in-flight token/fee cap and does not reduce the production 8192 output allowance.

pre_dispatch_checks: Recheck all registered source/PDF/fixture/plan/code/policy hashes before preparation and dispatch; a mismatch aborts.
Only the two original public PDFs enter the corpus; rubric, protocol, registration and source navigation never enter model messages.
Inspect final prepared source quotes against original PDF pages and stored character coordinates, including known PDF extraction warnings; content/coordinate validity is not semantic support.
Check actual final static cards, Insight fragments, source projections and shared input budgets; the policy inventory records possible fixed compositions, not proof that a card was included.
Read-only actual adapter message digest and source projection must match the accepted per-arm prepare values before socket dispatch; no retry, resampling or rewriting the task to repair a mismatch.
Compare the actual final OFF/AUTO messages for each question. A no-op pair is reported and not dispatched; four requests are permitted only if neither pair is a no-op and all checks pass.
Record actual per-arm system-policy hash and complete message digest from prepare; they are intentionally not invented in this pre-prepare registration.
Preserve incomplete pairs, failed/unknown dispatch receipts and all observed token/latency metadata; never silently replace an answer.
